output.summary: A deciduous or semi-evergreen vine native to South America, bluecrown passionflower climbs with tendrils and has lobed leaves. Its fragrant blue-and-white flowers have a striking multicoloured fringe, followed by oval orange fruit. The ripe fruit is edible to humans, though its flavour is sometimes described as bland or unpleasant.
